extraction.notes: Starting line is net income attributable to common stockholders (41,918). The company's diluted FFO (213,455) includes an add-back of Series E preferred distributions (1,231) that is not part of basic FFO (212,224); I included it as an 'other' FFO adjustment so ffo_total equals the diluted figure used for FFO as Adjusted and the subsequent steps tie. The basic FFO subtotal of 212,224 is noted here for reference. Checks: 213,455 + 4,241 = 217,696; 217,696 - 17,308 = 200,388; per-share figures reproduce from 356,280 diluted shares (0.60 / 0.61 / 0.56). Page for all lines: seq 9, printed page 3. Recurring capex is subtracted in AFFO, so recurring_capex_disclosed is null.
